title: Amiss record-set input
description: One specialist-produced normalized record set from which the offline CLI emits a self-asserted semantic template. Producer-defined digests are validated for shape but are not recomputed or authenticated by Amiss.

producer_identity.description: The stable identity of the specialist that normalized the records.

context_digest.description: The specialist-defined semantic context digest, including every toolchain, target, feature, or configuration input needed to interpret the rows.

input_digest.description: The specialist-defined digest of every source input needed to justify the records and completeness assertion.

complete.description: Whether the rows form the complete named set for the declared context and input.

name.description: The stable record-set identity selected by repository projection policy.

records.description: Rows in strictly increasing key order. Duplicate display values are allowed because keys own identity.
